pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed polygons resembling oak leaves with high-frequency edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients transitioning to the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light cream pathways with variable pixel thickness; junction nodes primarily consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections forming a stable lattice.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the visible upper neck mane, though intermittently occluded by foreground branch pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, prominent, exophytic nodular mass located on the lower neck and shoulder junction; exhibits a desaturated grayish-brown color with a cauliflower-like textural disruption.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant structural deformity caused by a large skin growth (potential GSD or papilloma) that creates a major deviation in the animal's natural shoulder silhouette.
